commit.message:
📜docs(workflow): align dispatch credential with SDK callers (#2)

The central workflow guide names a different dispatch secret from the
SDK callers. Update the credential setup to use `WORKFLOW_PAT` and
explain that its permissions must include Actions write on
`qortoo/qortoo-bench` alongside its other destinations.

Validation: compared the guide with both SDK caller workflows and ran
`git diff --check`. Documentation only; no workflow or secret settings
change.
